subject: general
question: Which of the following dynasties was ruling Magadha just before the establishment of the Mauryan empire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nanda.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Nanda Dynasty was founded by **Mahapadma Nanda.**
 
• Nanda Dynasty ruled the Magadha Empire during the **Alexander invasion **of India.
 
• Nanda Dynasty's time period was** 345 BCE–322 BCE.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​__Magadha Empire was ruled by three dynasties namely - **Haryanka Dynasty, **Shishunaga **Dynasty, and Nanda Dynasty.**
 
• **Haryanka Dynasty**
 
 
• **​**The Haryanka dynasty was founded by** Bimbisara.**
 
• He ruled the **Magadh empire** from 543 B.C. to 491 B.C.
 
• **The Capital **of Haryanka Dynasty was **Rajagriha.**
 
• **Bimbisara** was a follower of **Gautham Buddha.**
 
 
 
• **Shishunaga Dynasty**
 
 
• Last Haryanaka **King Nagdasaka** was not competent enough.
 
• People elected Shishunaga who was a **minister at King Nagdasaka's court,** as their ruler
 
• Thus Shishunaga dynasty was founded in **412 BC** and it extended up to 345 BC.​
